reports.title: Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Conference Call

lines: We now expect sales in the range of $8 billion to $8.2 billion, and adjusted proforma EBITDA of $930 million to $960 million, reflecting typical fourth quarter seasonality.
Fourth quarter sales are typically lower because of fewer inspection and delivery days around the holidays, and we expect the typical approximately 15% sequential decline.
We now expect 2026 proforma sales growth of approximately 8.0% at the midpoint, with sales ranging from $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion.
Finally, we are raising our free cash flow outlook to $360 million to $400 million for 2026, reflecting net
working capital efficiency and an updated capital expenditure outlook of $145 million for the full year.
